title: Cross-Border Keep-Back on Instant Payouts from a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
**Standing rule of the cross-border risk team.** The instant cross-border keep-back percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 4 percent when the international sales dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date are more than 0.3 (30 percent) of all sales dated in that month, 2 percent when they are more than 0.1 (10 percent) but not more than 0.3 of them, and nothing otherwise. Both are measured by sale amount; a sale is international when its buyer is recorded as outside the United States. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| International share of the rolling month's sales | Instant cross-border keep-back percentage |
|---|---|
| more than 30 percent | 4 percent |
| more than 10 percent, up to and including 30 percent | 2 percent |
| 10 percent or less | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical month with USD 10000.00 of sales)

| International sales | Share | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| USD 3000.01 | just over 30 percent | 4 percent |
| USD 3000.00 | exactly 30 percent | 2 percent |
| USD 1000.01 | just over 10 percent | 2 percent |
| USD 1000.00 | exactly 10 percent | none |
